label_definitions.contradiction: the identified contradiction with the cited declaration, or null
label_definitions.declaration_refs: relevance and traceability only; a reference alone never makes a record adverse
label_definitions.schema_validity: observed verdict of the runtime input validator on the after schema
label_definitions.semantic_expectation: proposal: adverse_under_current_declaration (only with a stated contradiction of the cited declaration), behavior_change_vs_before_schema (concrete schema change), unknown_requires_manual_review (meaning not established by declarations), exercise_only, rejected_by_schema, unknown (unsupported/unconstructible), not_applicable

limitations: Proposal for human review only: not a gold label, training data, approval, permission or evidence of observed runtime enforcement.
records.rationale: A new declaration must be reviewed for the new exact identity before any admission.

semantic_basis.note: declaration cited for relevance and traceability; no contradiction with it was identified
